package parents

import "context"

func (r *ParentRow) OnRelation(context.Context) {
	for _, row := range r.PrivateTimeline {
		r.Computed += row.Value
	}
	if r.PrivateSummary != nil {
		r.Computed += r.PrivateSummary.Value
	}
	// Deliberately retain populated holders: tags, not clearing values, hide them.
}
